name: Powerfully Green Solar
old_description: Locally Owned & Operated Since 2009        15+ Years of Energy Experience
about:
Powerfully Green Solar was founded in 2009 in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and has operated as a locally owned and operated contractor since its inception. The company holds a Minnesota building license (BC708267) and an electrical license (EA714757), and it maintains an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau.

The firm provides turnkey solar photovoltaic design and installation, battery storage integration, and time-of-use rate optimization for both residential and commercial customers. Its licensed building and electrical crews handle every project phase in-house, from initial energy assessment through permitting, installation, and commissioning. To date, the company reports more than 3,000 completed solar installations across Minnesota.

Primary markets include homeowners seeking to reduce utility bills and businesses looking to stabilize energy costs; commercial references cited by the company include the Twin Cities Berry Company. The company also assists agricultural clients with USDA Farm Service Agency financing options for solar projects.

Powerfully Green Solar emphasizes its “Built For Minnesota, Designed For You” approach, positioning its local licensing and end-to-end project management as differentiators in a market where many providers subcontract critical trades.
